misses.reply: Rubrik, ingress och inledningsstycke skrevs om, och alla tre mellanrubriker ersattes.
misses.judge_says: The closing summary is slightly inaccurate: "alla tre mellanrubriker ersattes". Two were replaced and one was added.
misses.check: input.md has two subheadings ("Kunden fick en gemensam bild", "Resultatet bevisar allt"); the returned text has three. Two replace the originals; "Maya Lind ser tillbaka på försöket" is new, inserted before the final quote. The text contradicts 'all three were replaced': only two existed to replace, and the third was added.

notes: Both judges note the typo 'förekoe' in Borttagna; neither calls a statement false over it, so it is not recorded.
